name: The Protagonist
work_style: People-focused leader who energises teams and drives collaboration. Natural facilitator and developer of human potential. Work best when helping others grow while advancing a meaningful goal.
decision_making: Weigh both data and human impact. Good at building consensus. Can over-prioritise team harmony at the expense of hard decisions.
leadership_style: Develop people actively. Lead through inspiration and genuine care. Build strong loyalty. Need to balance people focus with business requirements.
growth_edges: Making hard decisions that disappoint some
Avoiding over-extension from helping too many people
